responsibility: This .def file is the declarative specification of GCC's common target hook interface. It defines the members of the gcc_targetm_common hook vector, including hooks and POD defaults for target option parsing and initialization, optimization-default tables, target_flags initialization, exception-unwind model selection, split-stack support, valid option value enumeration, multilib selection overrides, unwind-table defaults, named-section support, and path canonicalization behavior; this specification is consumed by macro-based generators to build the hook struct, initializers, and related metadata.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the paired header, this file is the macro-driven .def specification that enumerates the common target hook members and their default initializers via DEFHOOK/DEFHOOKPOD, to be included by generators rather than included as a normal declaration header.
